Heavy-Duty Power. All-Season Comfort.

A Versatile Workhorse for Any Job.

The KIOTI NS4710HC combines robust performance with premium comfort for landowners, farmers, and contractors who need a dependable workhorse year-round. This utility tractor features a 45.3 HP KIOTI diesel engine, a fully enclosed climate-controlled cab, and a smooth 3-range hydrostatic transmission. With superior lifting capacity, power, and ergonomics, the NS4710HC handles everything from loader work to hay handling with ease.

Designed for hard work and harsh conditions, this tractor is ready to tackle demanding tasks in total comfort.

Features may include:

High-Performance Diesel Engine
Powered by a 4-cylinder, 45.3 HP KIOTI diesel engine for reliable, fuel-efficient output on any terrain.

Deluxe Climate-Controlled Cab
Factory-installed cab with heat and A/C, wide doors, and excellent visibility keeps you comfortable in every season.

Hydrostatic Transmission (HST)
3-range HST with twin pedal control ensures smooth direction changes and precision speed adjustment.

Category I 3-Point Hitch
Impressive 2,716 lbs lift capacity at the hitch point accommodates heavy-duty implements.

Independent Rear PTO
Easily operate powered attachments like mowers, tillers, and augers with manual or auto engagement options.

Power Steering & Controls
Standard power steering, tilt wheel, and ergonomic control layout reduce fatigue during long hours of work.

Durable & Dependable
Built with reinforced components, 4WD, and a rugged chassis for superior traction and long-term reliability.
